title: Reconcile canonical forum model with legacy communication ledger
description: Make modern messages and threads the canonical forward path while preserving historical ledger records and the forum seed as migration evidence.
acceptance_criteria: Modern messages have stable message_id and thread_id
Thread message_ids resolve to canonical messages
Historical ledger remains unchanged
Migration archive is explicitly non-canonical

title: Integrate forum lifecycle and traceability into the dashboard
description: Provide a real forum projection with thread status, replies, provenance, evidence, decisions, unresolved work and historical context.
acceptance_criteria: Forum consumes canonical messages and threads
Thread detail exposes replies and source references
Provenance is visible
Decision and work links are navigable
Legacy heuristic grouping is clearly marked as historical only

title: Unify event, decision, goal and verification traceability
description: Connect discussion, decisions, work, implementation, state events and goal effects so a change can be reconstructed end to end.
acceptance_criteria: Decisions reference originating discussions where applicable
Work items reference goals and evidence
Verification records can point to implementation and tests
Validator detects dangling references

title: Establish coordination integrity checks and security boundaries
description: Extend CI validation and security documentation so schema correctness, provenance, stale coordination records and runtime security limitations remain explicit.
acceptance_criteria: CI validates projects/central and shared semantic records
Dangling references and duplicate IDs fail validation
Security audit checks secret-like material and unsafe claimed-authority patterns
Runtime authentication remains explicitly outside the repository unless implemented

title: Add stale-state and verification visibility
description: Expose work whose dependencies, implementation state or verification evidence have fallen behind current repository reality.
acceptance_criteria: Stale work is detectable from structured timestamps and references
Implemented work without verification is visibly distinct
Superseded work is not counted as active
